title: Wow-wow mute and Patty Harmon
summary: Lewis featured him on rhythm with the first wow-wow mute, made by Patty Harmon.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Growl, plunger and derby: the trumpet mute tradition

blocks.x: Did Ted Lewis feature you much in solos and special numbers?

I used to sit down front. I used to use the first wow-wow mute ever made that Patty Harmon made. And he'd say, play me rhythm, Brunus. Give me rhythm. And I'd just have to hold the thing choked and pump out rhythm.
That was the regular Harmon mute then.
Yeah, it was the first one ever made. Patty Harmon gave it to him. He ran a dance hall. That's where Louie and Joao used to play.
Oh, is that the same Harmon mute? I thought it was the manufacturer.
No, that's... Harmon's dreamland. That's right. That's the guy who invented the wow-wow mute. I didn't know. I see.
There's some stuff you were wondering what to talk about. I never knew that in all my life.
I still got the mute. It's all batted up, but it's over at the level.
You have a little hole in the front that you can use your hand.
Yeah, it looked like a cuspidore.
